item.title: How to define state in Vuex
item.description: Defining proper state structure in Vuex is fundamental for building scalable Vue applications with predictable data flow and optimal reactivity. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve structured state for countless enterprise applications using clear, normalized patterns. The most effective approach is defining state as a function that returns an object with properly typed initial values. This ensures consistent data structure and prevents issues with state mutations and component reactivity.
